headline: Anthropic prices above range at $83 — Alphabet's stake gets a public mark Thursday
summary: GOOGL closed up 0.8% at $282.44 after two down sessions, still about 31% below its high. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above the $70–78 range; Google's ~$10B purchase at that price settles on listing, so Q4 earnings will carry a large mark-to-market swing. Nothing changes the thesis today.
